text:
tara: Quick sync: were validating the Delta Share <-> Databricks autoloader path into Redwood staging for the marketplace bundle. Goal: catch ordering and compacted-file edge cases.

noah: Sounds good. Are we including carriage-return heavy VARIANT blobs and nested arrays? Those caught us last quarter.

tara: Yes. Test matrix will include: carriage returns, multi-line JSON in VARIANT, parquet columns with repeated fields, and compaction windows that rewrite files mid-ingest.

jamie: Ill own the Delta Share publisher side. Will produce feeds with interleaved inserts/deletes and tombstones. ETA: tomorrow morning.

leo: On the Redwood side Ill exercise both batch pulls and streaming CDC. Need to confirm our dedupe window config (currently 30s). If file rewriting is faster than that we might drop updates.

integration-bot: Please file the compatibility run under RUN-2154-delta-autoloader with label "marketplace-preflight" and tag affected partners: Snowflake, Databricks, Qdrant.

tara: Proposed acceptance criteria:
- No data loss for upserts within dedupe window
- No invalid JSON passed to vectorizer stage
- Connector logs must surface file-rewrite events as WARN
- End-to-end latency < 12s for streaming path (95th) for our trimmed test load

noah: For autoloader config im using:```scala
spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles")
 .option("cloudFiles.schemaLocation", "/tmp/schema")
 .option("cloudFiles.useNotifications", "true")
 .option("cloudFiles.includeExistingFiles", "true")
 .load("s3://redwood-test/delta-share/")
```
Ill push the job link to the run ticket.

jamie: Delta Share producer will flip compaction every 10 minutes to simulate rewriting. Also will vary file sizes 1MB-120MB.

leo: Reminder: vector metadata limit is 4096 bytes by default. Ill add a test where metadata is 8KB to ensure truncation warnings are emitted.

sylvia: Ill add a temporary metric dashboard: "delta-autoloader-run-2154" and alert on >0 WARN file-rewrite events so the run team sees them in real time.

tara: Ownership: jamie (producer), noah (databricks autoloader), leo (redwood ingest & vectorizer), tara (coord + summary). Run window: Wed 11:00 PT, 2h. Quick sync at 13:00 PT for triage.

integration-bot: Ticket RUN-2154-delta-autoloader created and assigned.

noah: Ill also include a small script to replay a single-row tombstone repro if we encounter an ordering bug.

tara: Great. If anyone sees a blocker before Wed please ping @tara and drop repros into the ticket. :white_check_mark:
